policy.ability_semantics: Existing CFRU/DPE only; reviewed aliases retained, blocked/ignored/missing/ambiguous assignments never written.
policy.active_learnsets: CFRU src/Tables/level_up_learnsets.c only; DPE EXPAND_LEARNSETS is disabled
policy.early_level: Require nonempty sorted 0..100 rows, <=50 rows, valid nonzero u16 move IDs, and an eligible move at level 1 before writing.
policy.forms: Own coherent literal wins, even if older. Explicit changesFrom/battleOnly or missing-literal forme/baseSpecies follows pinned dex-species.ts; all possible battle parents must agree. Never inherit prevo/event/R moves. Only enumerated reviewed local ownership aliases and two existing-ID splits are allowed; other ambiguous forms fail closed.
policy.low_level_coverage: All active pointer targets checked conservatively at L1, stronger than normal encounters; no claim that every form is encounterable.
policy.selection: Select ONE generation for the exact species/form: Gen9 if any literal Gen9 L sources exist; otherwise newest earlier L dataset. Never keep older-only moves or mix generations. Incomplete/no-L1 selected data is blocked, not padded from history.
policy.tie_order: Showdown L strings specify levels, not in-game order within a level. Preserve canonical local relative order of surviving exact level/move pairs; append new same-level pairs in source property order. No older-only move can survive this ordering policy.

reference_lock.reference_role: NEW reproducible pilot reference; not the historical sync source
